channel.title: mint - companies
channel.description: Get the latest news and analysis on business, finance, politics from mint, the website of the Mint newspaper, one of India's leading business and financial dailies

item.title: Anthropic's 'largest IPO on record' ambition on hold? 'AI backlash could threaten timing, $1.5 trillion valuation'
item.description: Anthropic IPO: Three major investors who plan to take part in the offering told a US media outlet that the valuation would likely need to be lowered, with one saying it could end up closer to $1 trillion.

item.title: Musk's $470 million political bet: Why Tesla, SpaceX's Texas expansion faces a regulatory test after US midterms
item.description: Elon Musk's $470 million bet on Republicans has raised questions over Tesla and SpaceX's Texas expansion after Democrats won the US midterms. Investors fear tighter data-centre regulations could delay projects, increase costs and complicate a potential merger.

item.title: Tata Motors finds task cut out for Iveco turnaround after twin losses
item.description: Iveco lost €45 million in the September quarter, its second quarterly loss this year, just as Tata Motors took control. Tata must now turn it around while carrying acquisition debt and honouring conditions that block immediate restructuring.

item.title: PE firms turn to management incentives to drive growth and unlock exit value
item.description: Management incentives, paid over and above the pay package, can be seen as profit sharing and help private equity (PE) funds attract and retain top talent to lead portfolio companies through to exit, industry executives said.

item.title: Hertz Shares Plunge as Car Renter Warns It’s Running Low on Cash
item.description: Hertz Global Holdings Inc. shares plummeted after the car renter cautioned it expects to end the year with less cash and borrowing capacity than previously expected.

item.title: KFC launches themed menu and more as it teams up with Marvel's Doctor Doom for Avengers Doomsday campaign worldwide
item.description: KFC to team up with Marvel in its most expansive collaboration to date. Check when and where it will be available.

item.title: Anthropic is rapidly accelerating AI development amid slowdown calls, outside research group says
item.description: Anthropic is rapidly accelerating AI development amid slowdown calls, outside research group says

item.title: Who is Herjit Singh Bhalla? Dabur India appoints CEO as Whole-time Director for a five-year term from November 14
item.description: Dabur India has appointed India business CEO Herjit Singh Bhalla as an additional and whole-time director for five years from November 14, subject to regulatory clearances. Global CEO Mohit Malhotra will step down on November 13, 2026, after nearly three decades with the company.

item.title: Jio launches voice-only plans from ₹147: How do prices compare with Airtel and Vi?
item.description: Jio's voice-only prepaid offerings start at ₹147, which comes with a validity of 22 days. At the higher end, the company offers a ₹1,748 plan with a validity of 336 days.

item.title: Revolut confirms $115 billion valuation after latest share sale, up from $75 billion in less than a year
item.description: The secondary share sale, which began in July, allowed existing investors, including employees, to sell their holdings to other investors. The transaction did not involve the issuance of new shares by Revolut.

item.title: Titan misses Q2 revenue estimates but beats profit view as jewellery demand holds up
item.description: Demand for gold coins and investment products remains subdued, even as Titan sees stronger traction in lower-caratage jewellery and 24% growth in its jewellery portfolio.

item.title: SRTT tells charity commissioner its order ‘tied hands’ on Mehli reply
item.description: In filings before Maharashtra’s charity commissioner, former Tata Trusts trustee Mehli Mistry questioned Venu Srinivasan’s vote after his trustee tenure expired and challenged Noel Tata’s eligibility to serve on a charitable trust.&nbsp;

item.title: PhysicsWallah Q2 net profit more than doubles to nearly ₹144 crore as revenue rises 18%
item.description: PhysicsWallah Q2 net profit more than doubles to ₹143.63 crore as revenue rises 18%, driven by online growth and higher NEET enrolments.

item.title: Berger Paints misses Q2 profit estimates as raw material inflation squeezes margins
item.description: Berger Paints’ September-quarter profit rose 5% to ₹216.88 crore, missing analyst estimates as raw-material costs surged faster than prices. Revenue grew 13.2%, while gross margins narrowed.&nbsp;

item.title: Who is Cat Wu? Claude Code product chief joins OpenAI days after quitting Anthropic
item.description: OpenAI hires Anthropic’s Catherine Wu, who helped turn Claude Code into a commercial success, as it steps up competition in AI coding.

item.title: Flipkart delivering late amid festive season? Irked customers cancel orders, flag delay in iPhone 17 shipment
item.description: Flipkart customers have complained on social media about alleged delayed deliveries, repeatedly changing arrival dates, cancelled orders and deductions from refunds during the festive shopping season. The complaints include an iPhone 17 order delayed beyond its promised date.&nbsp;

item.title: Adani Ports to enter Europe with €2.56 billion buyout of Evos
item.description: The company will pay €1.18 billion in cash to buy 100% of Evos over 15 months, sealing its biggest buyout to date by enterprise value.

item.title: Blinkit’s free ambulance service: Why non-emergency rides cost ₹2,500, Deepinder Goyal explains
item.description: Blinkit has introduced ₹2,500 charge for non-emergency ambulance rides, while keeping emergency rides free. Deepinder Goyal said the move follows rise in bookings for routine check-ups and hospital transfers, which can tie up ambulances and trained paramedics needed for critical medical situations.

item.title: Emami weighs more acquisitions as digital-first brands zoom
item.description: This year, Emami acquired IncNut, owner of the skincare brands SkinKraft and Vedix, as well aloe-vera juice brand Alo Fruit.

item.title: Noel Tata's eligibility, ₹1.42 crore commission: Inside Mehli Mistry's fresh Tata Trusts challenge
item.description: Why has Mehli Mistry escalated his Tata Trusts dispute? His latest filings raise questions about Noel Tata's citizenship, trustee eligibility and an alleged ₹1.42 crore commission.

item.title: What CashKaro co-founder revealed on raising ₹130 crore for her startup while battling kidney failure
item.description: Swati Bhargava revealed that she underwent a kidney transplant while CashKaro was raising funds for its Series C round.

item.title: M&M Q2 consolidated PAT surges on strong SUV demand, beats Maruti and Hyundai
item.description: Company’s cost controls and pricing actions offset commodity inflation and rural demand weakness from an El Niño-hit monsoon.

item.title: Who is Rakesh Mehta, CHRO who has quit Welspun Corp after a 1-year stint? Why he resigned? What’s next for HR veteran?
item.description: Mehta's next professional move remains unknown. Neither Welspun Corp nor Mehta has announced any new assignment following his resignation.

item.title: Jio’s global ambitions: How US giants Comcast, Charter could help Mukesh Ambani's telecom company expand overseas
item.description: Jio Platforms is in talks with US cable giants Comcast and Charter to license its wireless broadband technology. How could the proposed partnerships help Mukesh Ambani expand overseas?

item.title: Narayana Murthy once wanted to work at Wipro. Why did Azim Premji turn him down? Here’s the story
item.description: Infosys founder Narayana Murthy once applied for a job at Wipro but Azim Premji turned him down. Years later, Premji called it one of his biggest mistakes.

item.title: Airtel's premium play fuels revenue beat, but user growth slows
item.description: Higher Arpu, postpaid additions and a strong Africa business lifted Airtel's September-quarter performance, even as net profit missed estimates and mobile subscriber additions slowed.

item.title: IDBI Bank stake sale: Why employees are protesting against Fairfax deal and demanding privatisation rollback
item.description: The proposed transaction, approved by the Indian government on October 14, involves the sale of a combined 60.72% stake held by the Centre and Life Insurance Corporation of India to Fairfax.

item.title: Why has ED attached ₹510 crore in Reliance Anil Ambani Group assets? 2 chartered planes, properties among those seized
item.description: The Enforcement Directorate (ED) on Tuesday said it has attached ₹510.17 crore worth of properties of Reliance Anil Ambani Group in connection with its ongoing alleged bank fraud cases involving its group companies.

item.title: Temple run: hotel chains chase footfalls over big profits in pilgrim centres
item.description: Radisson, Wyndham, Tamara and Alivaa are adding rooms in religious destinations, betting on domestic travel. But short stays and modest room rates can limit returns for mid-market hotels.

item.title: Client demand for shorter AI deals reshapes Google's cloud market battle
item.description: To be sure, cloud providers aren't the only ones seeing this shift. India's top IT services firms, which once relied on five-year, billion-dollar deals, are also increasingly reporting shorter deal tenures amid the rise of AI.

item.title: Crown new materials stock surge: How an ex-school teacher who left his job to make adhesive tapes became a billionaire
item.description: Chinese materials maker Crown New Materials raised CNY 956 million in its debut, with shares surging as much as 787%. The listing lifted co-founders Mai Michael and Mai Huixia to billionaire status,. The company supplies adhesive materials and films to customers including BYD, Apple and Tesla.

item.title: Google voluntary buyout: What do employees get in severance package? Which 7 countries are included? Explained
item.description: Google is using selective voluntary buyouts to manage costs and redirect resources toward AI and cloud computing. The offers cover employees in five countries, but the company has not disclosed full terms or take-up numbers. The approach follows earlier, division-specific exit programs.

item.title: Richest man on earth Elon Musk spent $224 mn to influence Texas Senate race? What Democrat win means for Tesla, SpaceX
item.description: The 2026 midterms delivered a major Democratic victory, including historic wins in Texas. Musk’s support for Republican candidates failed to prevent Democratic victories in Senate and governor’s races. The results could affect his Texas-based businesses and plans to expand AI infrastructure there.

item.title: Jungle Ventures targets two IPOs a year from its portfolio
item.description: The early-stage VC firm is preparing startups such as Moglix and Livspace for public markets while closing in on a fifth fund that will push its India bets past $1 billion.

item.title: From tunnel boring machines to rockets and pod taxis, L&T explores new manufacturing bets
item.description: Larsen and Toubro is exploring at least half a dozen new businesses ranging from nuclear fuel rods and tunnel boring machines to rockets and drones and their components
